title: Remove failing scores, count them
prompt:
Remove every score **below 60** from the list, returning **how many** were removed. Order of survivors must be preserved. Implement `process(java.util.ArrayList<Integer> list)`.

Example: `[70,50,80,40]` → returns `2`, list becomes `[70, 80]`.

tests.name: removal count
tests.hint: Iterate from the end so removals cannot shift unvisited indices; count each removal.
